scope: Static contract audit of pinned SDK LLVM IR, separate from host tests and target link.
fallback_abi: int(uint16_t, uint8_t *, int) for all seven classic families
dispatch: SDK generic families run before classic fallbacks; LE OGF8 uses original LE handler directly.
unknown_command: Fallback return 0 leaves the original common Command Complete event with status 0x01 in charge.
rng: HCI Rand invokes pseudo_random_genrate(dest, 8); each byte comes from the low 8 bits of a separate volatile 32-bit JL_RAND.R64L read at MMIO 0x13b00. Silicon entropy was not measured.
limits: No runtime vendor dispatcher or physical pairing test. Original classic-only command recognition changes to unknown in already LE-only image; no current app command depends on it.
